clues.text: He was plowing with twelve teams of oxen when a prophet passed by and threw his cloak around him.
Beside the Jordan, he asked his departing master to let him inherit a double portion of his spirit.
He sent word for Naaman, the Aramean commander, to wash seven times in the Jordan to be cleansed of leprosy.
In Shunem, he stretched himself out over a dead boy, who then sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
After boys near Bethel jeered at him as a baldhead, two female bears came out of the woods.
When a borrowed iron axe head fell into the Jordan, this man of God threw in a stick and made it float.
A dead man thrown into this prophet's tomb came back to life when his body touched the prophet's bones.
